metadata.title: [TESTING]: Investigate stale plugin parity and CPEX migration tests
metadata.author: lucarlig

description:
### ✅ Test Summary
Investigate whether `test-mcp-plugin-parity` is still useful after the plugin framework moved to CPEX, and clean up plugin tests that are now stale or validating removed/private implementation details.

The parity suite currently compares behavior across runtime modes, but for plugins we now effectively have a single CPEX implementation path. The test may still be useful as an end-to-end MCP plugin smoke test, but its current framing as parity may be misleading and some failures appear unrelated to the framework migration.

---

### 🧪 Test Type
Choose one or more applicable categories:

- [ ] Unit tests (Python)
- [x] Integration / end-to-end tests
- [ ] Manual UI testing (admin panel)
- [x] Transport coverage (HTTP, WebSocket, SSE, stdio)
- [ ] Federation / multi-gateway testing
- [x] Configuration / environment-specific behavior
- [x] Other (explain below)

Other: test maintenance after CPEX plugin framework migration.

---

### 🧬 Scope & Affected Components
Select what this test covers or validates:

- [x] `mcpgateway` core (API logic, handlers)
- [ ] Admin UI (HTMX / Alpine / Tailwind)
- [x] Tool/Resource/Prompt logic
- [ ] Federation sync/discovery
- [x] Server interactions or SSE
- [ ] Auth / JWT / security flows
- [ ] Observability (logging, metrics)
- [x] Makefile, shell scripts or CLI
- [x] Containerized setup (Docker/Podman)
- [x] Other (explain below)

Other: CPEX plugin framework integration tests and plugin runtime fixtures.

---

### 📋 Acceptance Criteria
What should pass or be verified?

- [ ] Decide whether `tests/e2e/test_mcp_plugin_parity.py` should remain a parity test, become a single-runtime plugin E2E smoke test, or be removed/replaced.
- [ ] If kept, rename or refocus the test so it validates current plugin behavior instead of obsolete Python-vs-Rust parity assumptions.
- [ ] Fix or remove stale plugin integration tests that target removed framework symbols, old Redis patch points, removed middleware kwargs, or private plugin internals.
- [ ] Ensure the remaining plugin test suite has clear coverage for tool/resource/prompt hooks under the current CPEX framework.
- [ ] Confirm test commands pass in the supported local/container setup, without requiring unrelated local-only assumptions.

---

### 📓 Additional Context & Steps
Initial investigation from PR #3754 found the main plugin unit/acceptance/service tests passing:

```bash
uv run pytest tests/acceptance/plugins tests/unit/mcpgateway/plugins tests/unit/plugins -q --tb=short
uv run pytest tests/unit/mcpgateway/services/test_prompt_service.py -k plugin -q --tb=short
uv run pytest tests/unit/mcpgateway/services/test_tool_service.py -k plugin -q --tb=short
uv run pytest tests/unit/mcpgateway/services/test_resource_service.py -k plugin -q --tb=short
```

`test-mcp-plugin-parity` needs a relevance review:

```bash
MCP_PLUGIN_PARITY_EXPECTED_RUNTIME=python MCP_CLI_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8080 make test-mcp-plugin-parity
```

Questions to answer:

- Is Python-vs-Rust plugin parity still meaningful for this repository after CPEX migration?
- If there is only one implementation path for each plugin, should this become a normal plugin E2E test instead?
- Are current failures testing real gateway behavior, or old fixture/runtime assumptions?

Stale or out-of-date tests observed during investigation:

```bash
uv run pytest tests/integration/test_resource_plugin_integration.py::TestResourcePluginIntegration::test_resource_filtering_integration --with-integration -q --tb=short
```

Fails because the test patches `mcpgateway.services.resource_service.PluginManager`, but that symbol no longer exists after CPEX migration.

```bash
uv run pytest tests/integration/test_plugin_runtime_redis.py::TestGlobalToggleRedis::test_enable_plugins_shared_writes_true --with-integration -q --tb=short
```

Fails because the fixture patches `mcpgateway.utils.redis_client`, while plugin runtime Redis access now goes through `mcpgateway.plugins._redis.get_shared_redis_client()` provider indirection.

```bash
uv run pytest tests/integration/test_rate_limiter.py::TestStoreCleanup::test_store_cleanup_between_tests --with-integration -q --tb=short
```

Fails because the test reaches into `RateLimiterPlugin._rate_backend`, but the current CPEX rate limiter no longer exposes that private attribute.

```bash
uv run pytest tests/integration/test_cross_hook_context_sharing.py --with-integration -q --tb=short
```

Fails because the test adds `HttpAuthMiddleware(plugin_manager=...)`, but the current middleware no longer accepts that argument.

Related stale references found by grep include old framework paths such as `mcpgateway.plugins.framework`, `mcpgateway/plugins/framework`, and old generated gRPC paths in docs/Makefile/test guidance. Those should be reviewed separately from runtime behavior and either updated to CPEX paths or removed if obsolete.
